authority: parent GO for ONE <=5-minute stdlib float/complex structure probe (Main IRC after 14:11 PDT); short-probe permission broadened only; exact-witness acceptance unchanged

objectives.W: f_W(q0)=sum_{M in {X^a,Z^a,X^aZ^(lam a)}, a=1..d-1} |<q0,M q0>|^2; W5 control d=5 lam=1 (solutions known); W10 d=10 lam in {1,3,7,9} (R4 open sub-case, B isotopic to Cay(Z10))
objectives.G: f_G=sum_lines(||S_L||_F^2-n), S_L=sum_{p in L} q_p q_p^*, lines=rows,cols,B-classes; G8 control B=i XOR j (solutions known); G6 calibration B=Cay(Z6) (no 1-RQLS(6) exists per Ball-Simoens as cited by source); G10 target B=Cay(Z10) (no classical mate; any solution non-classical)

method: projected gradient descent on unit spheres, adaptive step (accept if f does not increase: eta*=1.2 (W, cap 2.0) or 1.1 (G, cap 1.0); else reject and eta*=0.5), eta0=0.05
seeds: random.Random(20261018+k): W5 k=1; W10 k=10..13 for lam 1,3,7,9; G8 k=101; G6 k=102; G10 start s uses k=1000+s
guards: statvfs free >= 12e9 checked every 5 s inside run, else stop DISK_FLOOR; admission requires free >= 12.2e9 + 1 MiB projected growth; outputs one JSON (<1 MiB) created exclusively; RSS expected << 512 MiB; one process; no tool/subprocess timeout (bash timeout disabled), no SIGKILL, no ulimit
interpretation_rules: A numeric miss (no candidate) is UNKNOWN for that ansatz/B; not a restricted or unrestricted exclusion.
A numeric candidate is only a reconstruction lead; acceptance needs exact Q(zeta_N) certification of all norms, 30 ONBs, Latin B and 4950 nonparallel pairs by independent checkers plus reviews.
Controls: W5 and G8 should reach candidate thresholds (else the method is weak and misses are even less informative); G6 must not (else the method or threshold is broken).
